config.ROS2.env.distro.description: The ROS distribution to load (e.g. humble). Leave empty to use the environment default. Changing this re-collects the environment automatically.
config.ROS2.env.setupScript.description: Path to the ROS environment setup script (e.g. install/setup.bash). If empty: when pixiRoot is configured, its derived default script is used; otherwise a full path must be provided. Supports the ${workspaceFolder} variable. Changing this re-collects the environment automatically.
config.ROS2.env.pixiRoot.description: Root directory of the pixi environment. On Windows, leaving it empty falls back to c:\\pixi_ws; on non-Windows, empty means no derivation. Changing this re-collects the environment automatically.
config.ROS2.env.systemWatchFiles.descrip: Shell configuration files the environment collection depends on (e.g. ~/.bashrc); any change re-collects the environment. Supports ~ expansion and absolute paths; not watched on Windows. Changing this rebuilds the watchers from the new list automatically.
config.ROS2.build.installLayout.enum.aut: Platform default: merged install on Windows, isolated install on Linux/macOS
config.ROS2.build.installLayout.enum.mer: Merged install (--merge-install): all packages share a single install/ prefix (recommended on Windows: avoids overly long environment variables with many packages)
config.ROS2.build.installLayout.enum.iso: Isolated install (each package gets its own install/<package>/ prefix; colcon default, no extra flags)
config.ROS2.build.installLayout.descript: Install layout: merged = all packages share a single install/ prefix; isolated = each package gets its own install/<package> prefix (colcon default); auto = merged on Windows, isolated on Linux/macOS. Freely combinable with the install method (installMethod). After switching layouts, delete install/ and rebuild (colcon refuses to mix layouts). Takes effect on the next build.
config.ROS2.build.shareSpec.desc.templat: Command template text (including the command name), split by shell lexing (spaces and quotes) before execution. Placeholders may be arranged, repeated or omitted freely: ${base_path} workspace root; ${packages_select} selected-packages segment (disappears entirely when nothing is selected); ${clean} auto-clean segment; ${install_method}/${install_layout} the two install axes; ${1}..${n} the n-th preset; ${0} custom input (unused in the default template). Unknown placeholders are kept as-is and logged. An empty template = build is rejected (empty command).
config.ROS2.build.shareSpec.desc.custom: Description text for the "Custom input" entry; the entry only appears when the template uses ${0}.
config.ROS2.build.shareSpec.desc.argv_li: Preset slot table: the n-th entry fills ${n} in the template. Each element is a single { argv, describe }, or a group of mutually exclusive alternatives [ {…}, {…} ] (when a group holds multiple picks, only the first in written order applies). May be emptied (once empty and the template no longer uses ${0}, the secondary dialog no longer pops up).
config.ROS2.build.shareSpec.desc.argv: Argument segment filled into the slot when this preset is applied (may contain ${0} and named dynamic arguments; multiple segments allowed)
config.ROS2.build.shareSpec.description:
Build command template mechanism — the effective command is assembled from the fields below, then split by spaces and quotes and executed.

**Fields**: `template` — command template text (including the command name); placeholders may be arranged/repeated/omitted freely, unknown ones are kept as-is and logged, an empty template = build rejected. `argv_list` — preset slot table, the n-th entry fills `${n}`; each element is a single `{ argv, describe }` or a group of mutually exclusive alternatives (first in written order applies). `custom` — description of the "Custom input" entry; appears only when the template uses `${0}`.

**Placeholders**: `${base_path}` workspace root · `${packages_select}` selected-packages segment (disappears entirely when nothing is selected) · `${clean}` auto-clean segment · `${install_method}` / `${install_layout}` the two install axes · `${1}` … `${n}` presets · `${0}` custom input

**Example**:

```json
{
  "template": "colcon build ${install_method} ${install_layout} ${1}",
  "argv_list": [{ "argv": "--log-level debug", "describe": "Verbose output" }],
  "custom": "Custom input: hand-write arbitrary colcon arguments"
}
```

Deleting this setting restores the factory template. Takes effect on the next build.
config.ROS2.build.preflightWarnings.enum: Show none (checks and automatic fixes still run)
Silence only "silent no-op of method switching"; everything else still notifies
config.ROS2.build.preflightWarnings.desc: Notification mode for pre-build warnings (layout mismatch / install-method hard conflict / silent no-op of method switching). Checks always run; the automatic --cmake-clean-cache fix is unaffected. The "Don't ask again" button on the first silent-no-op notification writes this setting. Takes effect on the next build.
config.ROS2.build.allowEmptyWorkspace.de: Whether to allow an empty build when the workspace has no buildable packages: on = proceed as usual (initializes the build/install/log structure); off = refuse and notify. Applies immediately.
config.ROS2.build.installMethod.enum.aut: Auto (recommended): copy install on Windows, symlink install on Linux/macOS
config.ROS2.build.installMethod.enum.sym: Symlink install (--symlink-install): artifacts point back to the sources, so edits need no reinstall; on Windows requires Developer Mode or administrator rights
config.ROS2.build.installMethod.enum.cop: Copy install: artifacts are copied, no symlinks (colcon default behavior)
config.ROS2.build.installMethod.descript: Install method (three values aligned with the install layout installLayout: auto/symlink/copy). An explicit choice overrides the platform default; after switching, clearing install/ before rebuilding is recommended. Takes effect on the next build.
config.ROS2.run.shareSpec.desc.template: Command template text (including the command name), split by shell lexing (spaces and quotes) before execution. Placeholders: ${pkg} package name; ${executable} executable name; ${0} run-arguments input box (pre-filled with this executable's last arguments; remove it to stop the prompt); ${1}..${n} the n-th preset.
config.ROS2.run.shareSpec.desc.custom: Description text for the "Run arguments" input box; only appears when the template uses ${0}.
config.ROS2.run.shareSpec.desc.argv_list: Preset slot table: the n-th entry fills ${n} in the template. Once presets exist, the dialog upgrades from an input box to a multi-select list; checkbox memory is keyed by package/executable.
config.shareSpec.desc.argv: Argument segment filled into the slot when this preset is applied (may contain ${0}; multiple segments allowed)
config.ROS2.run.shareSpec.description:
Run command template mechanism — factory default = `ros2 run ${pkg} ${executable} ${0}`: an arguments box pops up on every run, pre-filled with this executable's last arguments.

**Fields**: `template` — command template text (including the command name). `argv_list` — preset slot table, the n-th entry fills `${n}`; once presets exist the dialog upgrades to a multi-select list, checkbox memory keyed by package/executable. `custom` — description of the run-arguments input box; appears only when the template uses `${0}` (remove it to stop the prompt).

**Placeholders**: `${pkg}` package name · `${executable}` executable name · `${0}` run-arguments input · `${1}` … `${n}` presets

**Example**:

```json
{
  "template": "ros2 run ${pkg} ${executable} ${0}",
  "argv_list": [],
  "custom": "Run arguments: arguments passed to the executable"
}
```

Deleting this setting restores the factory template.
config.ROS2.launch.yamlDefinitionEnabled: Go-to-definition in YAML launch files (F12, experimental): when off, no definition provider is registered for .launch.yaml at all (F12 gets no response from this extension), avoiding the definition indicator under string quotes; file-link underlines, hovers and completions are unaffected. Affects YAML only; XML and Python definitions are untouched. Applies after a window reload. Supersedes the former ROS2.launch.yamlNodeMatch setting.
config.ROS2.launch.shareSpec.desc.templa: Command template text (including the command name), split by shell lexing (spaces and quotes) before execution. Placeholders: ${pkg} package name; ${launch_file} install-relative path within the package (nested subpaths preserved); ${launch_path} absolute install-side path; ${0} launch-arguments input box (pre-filled with this file's last arguments; remove it to stop the prompt); ${1}..${n} the n-th preset.
config.ROS2.launch.shareSpec.desc.custom: Description text for the "Launch arguments" input box; only appears when the template uses ${0}.
config.ROS2.launch.shareSpec.desc.argv_l: Preset slot table: the n-th entry fills ${n} in the template. Once presets exist, the dialog upgrades from an input box to a multi-select list; checkbox memory is keyed by source file path (same-named launches in different packages stay separate).
config.ROS2.launch.shareSpec.description:
Launch command template mechanism — factory default = `ros2 launch ${pkg} ${launch_file} ${0}`: an arguments box pops up on every launch, pre-filled with this file's last arguments.

**Fields**: `template` — command template text (including the command name). `argv_list` — preset slot table, the n-th entry fills `${n}`; once presets exist the dialog upgrades to a multi-select list, checkbox memory keyed by source file path (same-named launches in different packages stay separate). `custom` — description of the launch-arguments input box; appears only when the template uses `${0}`.

**Placeholders**: `${pkg}` package name · `${launch_file}` install-relative path within the package (nested subpaths preserved) · `${launch_path}` absolute install-side path · `${0}` launch-arguments input · `${1}` … `${n}` presets

**Example**:

```json
{
  "template": "ros2 launch ${pkg} ${launch_file} ${0}",
  "argv_list": [],
  "custom": "Launch arguments: arguments passed to the launch file"
}
```

Deleting this setting restores the factory template.
config.ROS2.run.doctorCommand.descriptio: Full command string executed by the "Run ros2 doctor" command (split by spaces and quotes; the whole string is editable — append checks or output options). Applies on next execution.
config.ROS2.run.rosdepCommand.descriptio: Full command string executed by the "Install dependencies via rosdep" command (split by spaces and quotes; the whole string is editable — change the dependency path or append arguments). Applies on next execution.
config.ROS2.msg.systemRefreshMinutes.des: Refresh interval (minutes) for the rosmsg system message index; built-in types and workspace messages are unaffected. Applies immediately.
config.ROS2.msg.workspaceRescanMs.descri: Forced rescan period (milliseconds) for the rosmsg workspace message index, as a safety net for missed file events; 0 = disabled. Applies on the next cycle.
config.ROS2.msg.formatGradientStep.descr: Gradient step (characters) for rosmsg format column alignment: one tier per this length, each tier aligned to "longest type + 2 spaces". Larger values allow larger gaps. Applies on next format.
config.ROS2.msg.formatLineThreshold.desc: Single/double-line switch threshold (characters) for @optional annotations in rosmsg formatting: overly long merges split into two lines, short ones merge into one. Applies on next format.
config.ROS2.search.excludeFolders.descri: Additional folders excluded when scanning the workspace; affects package discovery, rosmsg/xacro/launch workspace search and test discovery. Relative paths resolve against the workspace root; supports ${workspaceFolder}. This list is append-only: 11 built-in artifact/dependency directory names (build, install, log, logs, devel, node_modules, .git, .hg, .svn, dist, out) are always excluded and cannot be un-excluded — listing them here has no effect. Applies automatically (cache invalidates and rescans, about 5–10 s).
config.ROS2.search.followSymlinks.descri: Whether directory searches follow symbolic links. Off by default (prevents traversal blowups caused by symlinks such as shared mount points); when on, link targets become searchable but traversal may get significantly slower. Applies automatically (package-scan cache invalidates and rescans in about 5–10 s; other searches immediately).
config.ROS2.search.walkTimeouts.descript: Per-search-type timeout/depth overrides: each entry is { type, totalTimeoutMs, branchTimeoutMs, maxDepth }, with type one of default/message/test/xacro/package; unconfigured entries use built-in defaults. Branch timeouts should be clearly smaller than total timeouts. Applies automatically (affects subsequent scans only).
config.ROS2.packages.refreshMs.descripti: Forced background rescan period (milliseconds) for the package list, 0 = disabled. Applies automatically (the background timer is re-armed with the new period).
config.ROS2.ide.intellisenseEngine.descr: Engine for automatic maintenance of header search paths (include entries). Switching only stops maintenance on the target side; files left behind by the other side are not deleted. Applies when the IntelliSense configuration is regenerated next.
Auto-select by installed extensions: use the single one present; if both or neither are installed, maintain both sides
Maintain only the cpptools side: include entries in .vscode/c_cpp_properties.json are added/removed automatically
Maintain only the clangd side: include entries in .clangd are added/removed automatically
Disable automatic maintenance; manage include entries fully by hand
config.ROS2.ui.autoShowOutput.descriptio: Automatically open the ROS 2 output channel when a warning or error occurs. Applies immediately.
config.ROS2.ui.showWelcomeOnStartup.desc: Show the welcome page after the extension is installed or updated. The "Don't show again" button in the notification writes this setting. Applies on next launch.
